title: File type filters
description:
Build the filter list for an Open dialog, both the old double-zero string and the modern list of pairs.

```
filters: Text files (*.txt;*.md), Images (*.png;*.jpg), All files (*.*)
old style: "Text files\0*.txt;*.md\0Images\0*.png;*.jpg\0All files\0*.*\0\0"
modern: 3 COMDLG_FILTERSPEC entries
```
hints: `s += name; s += '\0'; s += spec; s += '\0';` for each, then one more `'\0'` (lesson 3.02).
A `std::string` can hold zeros, but `printf("%s")` stops at the first one: print character by character.
requirements: Build the `\0`-separated string ending with a double `\0`, and print it with the zeros shown as `\0`.
Build a vector of (name, spec) pairs for `IFileDialog::SetFileTypes`.
stretch: Pick the default filter from the extension of the current file.
